_comment: Capability catalog (TOOL-01) — versioned registry of systems the harness may reach. Read by BOTH gsd-tools.cjs (Node) and capability_schema.py (Python). Entry 'name' is a STABLE ID: Phase 67's PreToolUse hook consumes this catalog as its allowlist — never rename/remove a name without a catalog_version bump. Auth stores method + env-var NAME only, never secret values. Author entries via 'gsd-amauta capability add'; 'gsd-amauta capability audit' catches hand-edit schema drift.

entries.name: amauta-daemon-http
entries.notes: Local Amauta daemon HTTP API (tasks, memory, audit). Port override: GSD_AMAUTA_PORT.

entries.name: amauta-postgres
entries.notes: Primary PG store. DSN carries credentials — responses are evidence-scrub targets (MOBL-04 foundation).

entries.name: amauta-valkey
entries.notes: Valkey/Redis — circuit breakers, semantic cache. Default redis://127.0.0.1:6379/0.
